pageTitle: Klacks for Saudi Arabia | Shift Optimization, Not Another HRIS

hero.badge: For security, facility & hospital operators in Saudi Arabia
hero.titleHtml: Keep your HR system. Fix your shift planning.
hero.subtitle: ZenHR, Bayzat and similar platforms handle GOSI, Mudad and WPS filings well — but their built-in schedulers are rudimentary. Klacks is the specialised 24/7 shift-optimization engine that feeds your existing payroll system, not another silo to maintain.
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the core app interface ships in German, English, French and Italian; the Klacksy AI assistant additionally understands Arabic.

challenges.title: The optimisation gap in existing HR suites

items.title: Schedulers built as an afterthought
items.text: All-in-one HR platforms handle visas, contracts and government filings well, but their shift planners are little more than static spreadsheets — useless for real 24/7 rotations.

items.title: Manual overtime & allowance tracking
items.text: Night, holiday and split-shift allowances get tracked by hand, then re-typed into payroll — slow and error-prone.

items.title: Friday/Saturday week, 24/7 coverage
items.text: Guard posts, wards and facilities still need gap-free coverage across the Friday/Saturday weekend rhythm.

solutions.title: How Klacks fits into your existing stack
solutions.subtitle: Best-of-breed, not another all-in-one compromise.

items.title: Purpose-built shift optimisation
items.text: Klacks solves the hard 24/7 rotation math — guards, wards, facility teams — that generic HR schedulers can't.

items.title: Export straight into your payroll
items.text: Klacks already exports finished hours, overtime and allowances to CSV/Excel; a ready-made Gulf payroll column preset for ZenHR/Bayzat imports is next on our roadmap.

items.title: Instant replacement on absence
items.text: The Recovery Engine finds the best qualified stand-in the moment a shift is short-staffed — no more working the phones.

items.title: Friday/Saturday week built in
items.text: Klacks' calendar rules handle the regional weekend and holiday pattern natively — not bolted on.

items.title: Open source, on-premise
items.text: Klacks is open source and can run entirely on your own infrastructure — relevant wherever data residency (PDPL) matters, with no vendor lock-in.

example.title: One optimisation engine, your existing payroll
example.text: Klacks plans the rotation, tracks allowances, and hands off a clean export — your HR platform still owns GOSI, Mudad and WPS filing, exactly where it's strongest.

cta.title: See Klacks alongside your HR system
cta.text: Try the Playground to see how Klacks optimises 24/7 rotations and exports finished hours — or run it on-premise for full data residency.
